questions.question: Dr. YOUSSEF must train young dentists on the importance of the union. What is the first piece of advice he should give them?
options: The union is an administrative constraint
The union is the collective strength of the profession
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'The union is the collective strength of the profession.' MIKOU: 'I completely agree, I've understood that!'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU must create a union training center. What is the main objective?
questions.explanation: MIKOU explains: 'The objective is to train dentists in union engagement.' YOUSSEF: 'I will participate in this training.'

questions.question: Dr. YOUSSEF must evaluate the performance of a young dentist in terms of union engagement. What measure is the most important?
options: The number of meetings they attend
The quality of their involvement and contribution
The number of colleagues they recruit
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'The quality of involvement and contribution is the most important measure.' MIKOU: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU must manage a crisis: a colleague has been unjustly convicted. What is the priority?
options: Mobilize the union to support them
questions.explanation: MIKOU explains: 'The priority is to mobilize the union to support the colleague.' YOUSSEF: 'I will help you manage this situation.'

questions.question: Dr. YOUSSEF must train residents in union risk management. What is the fundamental principle?
options: Union risk management is a responsibility
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'Union risk management is a fundamental professional responsibility.' MIKOU: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU must create a guide to good union practices. What is the main reference?
options: The labor code and union bylaws
questions.explanation: MIKOU explains: 'Good practices must be based on the labor code and union bylaws.' YOUSSEF: 'I will contribute to this guide.'

questions.question: Dr. YOUSSEF must train young dentists in optimizing union engagement. What is the key message?
options: Optimizing engagement is a service to the profession
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'Optimizing engagement is a service to the profession.' MIKOU: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU must create a research program on dental unionism. What is the main objective?
options: Improve union practices and the defense of the profession
questions.explanation: MIKOU explains: 'Research aims to improve union practices and the defense of the profession.' YOUSSEF: 'I will participate in the research.'

questions.question: Dr. YOUSSEF must create a reference center for union matters. What is the pillar of excellence?
options: Quality of engagement and collective defense
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'Excellence is based on the quality of engagement and collective defense.' MIKOU: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU must evaluate the impact of the union on the profession. What is the role of the union?
options: It is essential for the defense and promotion of the profession
questions.explanation: MIKOU explains: 'The union is essential for the defense and promotion of the profession.' YOUSSEF: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. YOUSSEF must train residents in union innovation. What current trend is important?
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'Innovation concerns digitalization, social media, and new forms of engagement.' MIKOU: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU must create a union skills evaluation system. What is the objective?
questions.explanation: MIKOU explains: 'Evaluation aims to improve union practices.' YOUSSEF: 'I will participate in the evaluation.'

questions.question: Dr. YOUSSEF must manage an internal union conflict. What is the right attitude?
options: Respect the bylaws and promote dialogue
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'Dialogue and respect for the bylaws are essential to resolve internal conflicts.' MIKOU: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU must write an article on the future of dental unionism. What trend should be emphasized?
questions.explanation: MIKOU explains: 'The future depends on the necessary modernization and adaptability of unions.' YOUSSEF: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. YOUSSEF must create a union quality label for practices. What are the main criteria?
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'Union engagement and rights defense are the fundamental criteria.' MIKOU: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU must give a speech on the importance of the union. What message should he convey?
options: The union is the heart of professional solidarity
The union is of no interest
questions.explanation: MIKOU explains: 'The union is the heart of professional solidarity.' YOUSSEF: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. YOUSSEF must create a scholarship for students in unionism. What is the objective?
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'Encouraging excellence in union engagement is an investment for the future.' MIKOU: 'I will support this initiative.'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU must pass on his union knowledge. What is the most effective method?
questions.explanation: MIKOU explains: 'Personalized mentoring and role-playing are the most effective methods.' YOUSSEF: 'I will invest myself in mentoring.'

questions.question: Dr. YOUSSEF must create a peer network for young unionized dentists. What is the objective?
options: Foster mutual help and sharing of experiences
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'Mutual help and sharing are essential for young unionized dentists.' MIKOU: 'I will support this network.'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU must write a conclusion to his book on unionism. What is the final sentence?
options: The union is the strength of professional unity
questions.explanation: MIKOU explains: 'The union is the strength of professional unity.' YOUSSEF: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. YOUSSEF must leave a legacy to the profession. What is the most beautiful legacy?
options: Union skills and a role model to follow
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'Union skills and a role model are the most beautiful legacy.' MIKOU: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU must train future union mentors. What is the first message to convey?
options: Mentoring is a mission of accompaniment and transmission
Mentoring is a source of income
questions.explanation: MIKOU explains: 'Mentoring is a mission of accompaniment and transmission.' YOUSSEF: 'I will convey this message.'

questions.question: Dr. YOUSSEF must write a letter to future dentists about the union. What message should he convey?
options: The union is a pillar of the profession
The union is of no interest
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'The union is a pillar of the profession.' MIKOU: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU must create an award for young unionized dentists. What is the purpose?
questions.explanation: MIKOU explains: 'Stimulating excellence in union engagement is essential for the evolution of the profession.' YOUSSEF: 'I will support this award.'

questions.question: Dr. YOUSSEF, after a career dedicated to unionism, receives a national tribute. Dr. MIKOU is by his side. What is YOUSSEF's message to young dentists?
options: The union is the strength of our profession
The union is of no interest
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF concludes: 'The union is the strength of our profession. It gives meaning to our engagement.' MIKOU: 'I am proud of you.'
